messages:
emily: Heads-up  the tenant cost card for tenant 'horizon' shows an unexpected drop in net unit cost around the 10:30 canary. Looks like prefetch credits got applied twice. anyone seen dup credits before?
raj: hmm that rings a bell. we recently added a prefetch_credit ledger at ingress and also applied a separate cache credit at the router. if both were subtracted from the same window it could double-count.
tam: can you attach the window sample? curious whether credits were stamped as "prefetch_credit" vs "cache_hit_credit". we treat them differently today.
emily: sample window: 2024-07-02T10:20Z->10:40Z. UI: unit $0.009/token, baseline $0.015, credits -$0.006/token. raw rows look like: `window,tenant,requests,tokens,credits\n1717776000,horizon,2400,120000, -720`
nina: looks like credits are recorded as absolute cost offsets in cents, and then UI converts to per-token. but router-level crediting also emitted a small per-request credit which got aggregated into the same window.
raj: short-term mitigation: flag windows with >1 credit_source in the payload and show a badge "multiple credit sources" on the card. will help ops spot dupes.
tam: longer term: unify crediting to a single canonical field: credits_by_source = "prefetch: -600,router: -120". keep top-K sources only to bound size.
emily: UI idea: add an "explain credits" expand where we show credits_by_source and a small timeline of when credits were applied. helpful for customers and SREs.
nina: also need to fix denominator handling: currently cached-prefetch responses set tokens_compute=0 which reduces the token base and inflates per-token savings. instead we should report tokens_cached separately and keep tokens_total as denom.
raj: agree. proposed telemetry additions: credits_histogram (csv), tokens_total, tokens_cached, prefetch_credit_amount, router_credit_amount, credit_sources_count. Keep the CSV compact: "prefetch:-600,router:-120".
tam: payload size should be tiny if we cap sources to 4 and compress ints. we already do top-K variant histograms, same pattern.
emily: product question: do we change billing math if we unify credits? billing: please chime in.
billing-bot: Billing note: any change to billed credits must be approved by FIN+LEGAL. UI and telemetry changes for visibility are fine; do not change invoice computation without PM sign-off. I've filed INF-7007 to track.
emily: ok. action items: (1) raj to add credits_histogram + tokens_cached to telemetry (INF-7010) (2) tam to add UI "explain credits" expand + badge (INF-7011) (3) nina to run quick sampling job to find other windows with multiple credit sources (INF-7012).
raj: will prototype CSV format and post example.
tam: will mock the UI expand in staging tomorrow.
emily: thanks folks. labeling these as "explainability" work so billing isn't surprised.
billing-bot: Tickets INF-7010, INF-7011, INF-7012 created.
